tagline: Theory, activity, ecology: the activity model that decides which methods to activate
role: OaaS structures everything in the trinity of theory (beliefs about the world), activity (what we do: review a book, write a critique, brief an executive) and ecology (actors and stakeholders). The dictations say the activity should drive which reasoning modules the Master activates and in what output form. It also hosts the dictation loop and the Kering material.
contributes: the activity model (inputs, outputs, expected outcomes per activity)
